items.content: Origin / Chronohaze Fay / Feier Lyu OPTIMIZATION · FORMAL VERIFICATION · MACHINE-CHECKED MATHEMATICS In the haze of time, I look for structure in complexity. Proof asks what can be trusted; music and image ask what deserves to be remembered. This site gathers the work that continues between them. items.content: Selected Work Research Statement Technical Notes Academic 学术 Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 我研究优化理论与形式化验证。 当前工作集中在可复用的 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施，以及网络定位中的图结构负曲率证书。 教育背景 爱丁堡大学 数学本科 · 预计 2027 年毕业 康奈尔大学 交换学习 · 2025–2026 主要研究线 机器检查优化 子模最大化与 projected first-order methods 的 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施 网络定位 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach 合作研究负曲率证书与局部逃逸方向 Academic Academic Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) I work on optimization theory and formal verification. My current work centers on reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure and graph-structured negative-curvature certificates for network localization. items.excerpt: Selected formalizations, optimization notes, research directions, and a supporting computational prototype.
items.content: Selected Work Research Statement Technical Notes Selected Work Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 按 Published、Submitted、Ongoing collaboration 与 Exploratory notes 四类展示可核查的学术工作；创意计算原型单独列为 side project。 Selected Work Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Verifiable academic work is separated into Published, Submitted, Ongoing collaboration, and Exploratory notes. A creative-computation prototype is listed separately as a side project. ACADEMIC WORK 学术工作 PUB PUBLISHED · FORMAL VERIFICATION Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 状态： 2026 年 5 月 26 日正式发表于 AFP。AFP 条目覆盖 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy；当前仓库另含发表后的 stochastic-greedy 扩展，包括 sampling、approximation packaging 与 oracle-cost accounting。 问题： 形式化基数约束单调子模最大化中 classical greedy 的经典 1−1/e 近似保证。 贡献： 在 Wenda Li 老师指导下，本人负责完整的 Isabelle/HOL development，覆盖 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy variant。 证据： AFP Proof document GitHub DOI SUB SUBMITTED · FORMAL VERIFICATION First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL 状态： 2026 年 7 月 2 日提交至 Archive of Formal Proofs，目前等待审核。 问题： 将 projected gradient descent 及其一阶收敛理论组织成可复用的 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施。 贡献： Independent formalization project；本人负责完整 Isabelle/HOL development，覆盖 projection geometry、projected-gradient mapping、凸收敛与强凸线性收敛率。 证据： Project page GitHub JOINT ONGOING COLLABORATION · NETWORK LOCALIZATION Negative-Curvature Certificates for Network Localization 状态： Ongoing collaboration with Prof. Shoham Sabach. 问题： 对网络定位中的非最优驻点，哪些图结构与几何条件能给出负曲率证书和可计算的局部逃逸方向？ 贡献： 当前合作围绕 cycle consistency、projected edge budgets、图的环空间与 Hessian 负曲率之间的联系展开。 证据： English technical note Research note Derivation history NOTE EXPLORATORY NOTE · MINIMAX OPTIMIZATION TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 状态： Exploratory derivation. 问题： Two-timescale value-function tracking 是否能通过 Schur-complement Hessian 支持二阶 saddle escaping？ 贡献： 通过已有的 value-function viewpoint 探索 TTGDA，梳理二阶 tracking gap 与可继续检验的 theorem-level 路线。 证据： Note CREATIVE COMPUTATION Experimental Prototype SIDE CREATIVE COMPUTATION / EXPERIMENTAL PROTOTYPE Metalcore Piano Lab 状态： Side project · experimental prototype · work in progress；不作为 research output。 问题： 如何把连续的 audio / rhythm streams 转换为保留节拍、段落与可玩性约束的离散谱面？ 贡献： 设计并实现 browser-native 分析与谱面生成原型，包括 onset、beat-grid、section alignment 与 playability constraints。 证据： GitHub Project note ACADEMIC WORK Academic Work PUB PUBLISHED · FORMAL VERIFICATION Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Status: Published in the Archive of Formal Proofs on May 26, 2026. The AFP entry covers classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant; the current repository additionally contains a post-publication stochastic-greedy extension with sampling, approximation packaging, and oracle-cost accounting. Problem: Formalize the classical 1−1/e approximation guarantee for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. Contribution: I was responsible for the full Isabelle/HOL development under the supervision of Wenda Li, covering classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant. Evidence: AFP Proof document GitHub DOI SUB SUBMITTED · FORMAL VERIFICATION First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Status: Submitted to the Archive of Formal Proofs on July 2, 2026; awaiting review. Problem: Formalize projected gradient descent and its first-order convergence theory as reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure. Contribution: Independent formalization project. I was responsible for the full Isabelle/HOL development, covering projection geometry, projected-gradient mapping, convex convergence, and a strongly convex linear rate. Evidence: Project page GitHub JOINT ONGOING COLLABORATION · NETWORK LOCALIZATION Negative-Curvature Certificates for Network Localization Status: Ongoing collaboration with Prof. Shoham Sabach. Problem: For non-optimal stationary points in network localization, which graph and geometric conditions yield a negative-curvature certificate and a computable local escape direction? Contribution: The collaboration currently studies the relation among cycle consistency, projected edge budgets, the graph cycle space, and Hessian negative curvature. Evidence: English technical note Research note Derivation history NOTE EXPLORATORY NOTE · MINIMAX OPTIMIZATION TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking Status: Exploratory derivation. Problem: Can two-timescale value-function tracking support second-order saddle escaping through the Schur-complement Hessian? Contribution: Explored TTGDA through the established value-function viewpoint, isolated the second-order tracking gap, and organized a theorem-level route for further verification. Evidence: Note CREATIVE COMPUTATION Experimental Prototype SIDE CREATIVE COMPUTATION / EXPERIMENTAL PROTOTYPE Metalcore Piano Lab Status: Side project · experimental prototype · work in progress; not presented as a research output. Problem: How can continuous audio / rhythm streams become discrete charts while preserving beat, section, and playability constraints? Contribution: Designed and implemented the browser-native analysis and chart-generation prototype, including onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints. Evidence: GitHub Project note
